data.name: Istighfar
data.gender_notes: Istighfar is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Asking Allah for forgiveness and guidance. The name Istighfar carries the meaning “Asking for Forgiveness” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Istighfar usually hope their child will grow to embody asking for forgiveness and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A reminder to always seek Allah's forgiveness and guidance in all aspects of life
data.etymology: Istighfar belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Asking for Forgiveness.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Istighfar total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

in_arabic.name: استغفار
in_arabic.meaning: الله سے معافی مانگنا، گناہوں کی بخشش
in_arabic.long_meaning: استغفار کا مطلب ہے اللہ سے معافی مانگنا، اپنے گناہوں کی بخشش مانگنا۔ یہ لفظ 'غفر' سے ماخوذ ہے جس کا مطلب ہے چھپانا، ڈھانپنا۔ جب کوئی شخص استغفار کرتا ہے تو وہ اپنے گناہوں کو چھپانے اور اللہ کی رحمت حاصل کرنے کی درخواست کرتا ہے۔ قرآن میں استغفار کی تاکید کی گئی ہے اور یہ مسلموں کے لیے روحانی صفائی اور اصلاح کا ایک اہم ذریعہ ہے۔

in_urdu.name: استغفار
in_urdu.meaning: اللہ سے معافی مانگنا، گناہوں کی بخشش
in_urdu.long_meaning: استغفار اللہ سے معافی مانگنے کا ایک طریقہ ہے۔ یہ 'غفر' سے ماخوذ ہے جس کا مطلب ہے چھپانا یا ڈھانپنا۔ جب ہم استغفار کرتے ہیں تو ہم اپنے گناہوں کو چھپانے اور اللہ کی رحمت حاصل کرنے کی درخواست کرتے ہیں۔ یہ مسلموں کے لیے اپنے گناہوں سے توبہ کرنے اور اللہ کی بخشش حاصل کرنے کا ایک اہم طریقہ ہے۔

in_hindi.name: इस्तिग़फार
in_hindi.meaning: ईश्वर से क्षमा मांगना, पापों की माफी
in_hindi.long_meaning: इस्तिग़फार का अर्थ है ईश्वर से क्षमा मांगना और अपने पापों की माफी मांगना। यह शब्द 'ग़फ़र' से लिया गया है जिसका अर्थ है छुपाना या ढाँपना। जब कोई व्यक्ति इस्तिग़फार करता है तो वह अपने पापों को छुपाने और ईश्वर की कृपा प्राप्त करने का अनुरोध करता है। यह मुसलमानों के लिए आध्यात्मिक शुद्धि और सुधार का एक महत्वपूर्ण साधन है।

in_pashto.name: استغفار
in_pashto.meaning: د الله څخه د معافی غوښتنه، د ګناهونو بخشش
in_pashto.long_meaning: استغفار د الله څخه د معافی غوښتنې لپاره کارول کیږي. دا د 'غفر' څخه اخیستل شوی دی چې معنی یې د پټولو یا پوښلو. کله چې کوم څوک استغفار کوي نو هغه د خپلو ګناهونو څخه د خلاصون او د الله د رحمت ترلاسه کولو غوښتنه کوي. دا د مسلمانانو لپاره د روحاني پاکۍ او اصلاح یو مهم وسیله ده.

in_english.name: Istighfar
in_english.meaning: Seeking forgiveness from Allah, asking for pardon of sins
in_english.long_meaning: Istighfar is an Arabic term that means seeking forgiveness from Allah, asking for pardon of sins. It is derived from the root 'gha-fara' which means to cover or hide. When a person makes istighfar, they are asking Allah to cover their sins and grant them mercy. Istighfar is a vital aspect of Islamic spirituality, encouraging believers to repent and seek forgiveness for their wrongdoings. It is mentioned in the Quran and is considered a means of spiritual purification and reform.

data.cultural_impact: In Islamic culture, the practice of seeking forgiveness from Allah (Istighfar) is a fundamental aspect of daily life. Believers are encouraged to ask for forgiveness frequently, especially before performing the daily prayers. This practice not only strengthens the bond between the individual and Allah but also serves as a reminder of Allah's mercy and compassion. It is a way to maintain a constant connection with the divine and seek His guidance in all aspects of life.
data.spiritual_significance: Spiritually, the act of Istighfar is a humbling experience that signifies the weakness and dependence of humans on Allah. It is a reminder that we are all sinners in need of Allah's mercy and forgiveness. Through this practice, individuals can clear their minds of sinful thoughts, negative emotions, and blockages that prevent them from fully connecting with Allah. It allows us to renew our commitment to living according to Allah's guidance and ultimately seeking His pleasure in all aspects of our lives.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Istighfar, in Islamic tradition, is the act of seeking forgiveness from Allah (God). It is a reminder of our human imperfection and our reliance on Allah's mercy and compassion. By making Istighfar, we humbly acknowledge our shortcomings and turn towards Allah in repentance, seeking His infinite grace and forgiveness.

islamic_reference.note: Traditional Islamic name with deep spiritual significance in Islamic culture

historical_references.reference: Ibn Qayyim Al-Jawziyya, in his book 'Miftah Al-Jannah' (The Key to Paradise), mentions Istighfar as a means of seeking forgiveness from Allah and a powerful act of worship. He relates it to the story of the Prophet Yunus (Jonah), who, after being thrown into the sea, repented and was forgiven by Allah. This occurred during the early Islamic period, around the 14th century CE.
historical_references.context: A scholar's explanation of the importance and power of seeking forgiveness through Istighfar, referencing the story of Prophet Yunus

historical_references.reference: Ibn Al-Jawzi, in his book 'Al-Tawhid Wal-Rabaniyah' (Monotheism and Asceticism), writes about the significance of Istighfar as a form of supplication and a means of gaining Allah's mercy and forgiveness. He mentions it as being one of the practices of the early Salaf (pious predecessors) and emphasizes its importance during times of hardship or adversity. This account is from the 12th century CE.
historical_references.context: A scholar's discussion on the importance and historical practice of Istighfar as a form of supplication for mercy and forgiveness

trends: Classic Islamic name maintaining steady popularity
modern_usage.modern_context: The name Istighfar remains relevant in modern Muslim society, representing a bridge between traditional Islamic values and contemporary life. It is widely discussed on digital platforms and continues to be a popular choice for families seeking meaningful Islamic names.
